field_text_formatted.value: And if nothing on the site has the right field type yet (say you're building an image formatter before any image field exists), Devel Generate support steps in. It builds a throwaway sample entity for the preview instead of leaving it blank, so you're never creating a dummy node just to see your formatter render.
